settings.title: Settings
settings.host_helper: Public host name eLabFTW is published on (SITE_URL). It must resolve to this server.
settings.secret_is_set: A value is currently stored — leave blank to keep it.
settings.ldap_url_helper: Use ldaps:// (port 636) for TLS or ldap:// (port 389). Self-signed certificates are accepted.
settings.ldap_user_attribute_helper: Attribute matched against the login name: sAMAccountName for Active Directory, uid for OpenLDAP. Several attributes may be separated by commas.
settings.ldap_mail_attribute_helper: eLabFTW requires an e-mail address for every user. On Active Directory with empty mail fields use userPrincipalName.
settings.timezone_helper: TZ database name for PHP and the database, e.g. Europe/Berlin.
settings.max_upload_mb_helper: Largest attachment a user may upload.
settings.web_url_desc: Open eLabFTW in the browser at {url}
settings.first_steps_desc: The first account of the instance — registered on the registration page or created by the first LDAP login — becomes the system administrator; later accounts are validated by an admin. LDAP users log in with their directory account and pick their team on first login. Teams, timestamping and mail are managed in eLabFTW's sysadmin panel.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: This host name is already used by another instance.
settings.ldap_validate_cert: Validate LDAPS certificate (off for self-signed certificates)
